answer.book: Single-work Latin theological volume (Geneva 1613): Jacobus Amport's (ad Portum) Orthodoxae fidei defensio, a chapter-by-chapter refutation of Ostorrodius's Institutiones, preceded by a dedicatory letter, commendatory verses and a note to the reader, and followed by three indices.
